title: Page 2
lines: 当时他乐得作梦都会笑，只是这样的美好成亲没几年就磨得差不多了。
想到刘彩凤坚持要将赵小丫嫁给个傻子，他心中不舍又愧疚，原本就瘦弱的身子更显出老态。
或许嫁给个傻子也是好的……看着水沸冒出的白烟，赵老爹的眼迷蒙了起来。
离开赵家，没了刻薄偏心的娘，小丫的日子过得应该会比如今更好才是。
纵是自欺，他也只能抱着这想法日过日。
赵小丫股脑的冲出家门，没跑多远就觉得浑身失了力气。
她大口喘着气，忍着晕眩，明明是个已经要及笄的姑娘，但面黄肌瘦、骨瘦如柴，顶多像个十岁的孩子。
她摇摇晃晃的走上山径，她住的村子四周被绵延不绝的高山环绕，夜深人静时偶尔还会听见深山里传来狼嗥声。
村民平时采摘野菜、野果都不敢往深山走，就怕个运气不好遇上狼群，死无全尸。
但赵小丫打小就被逼着上山干活，平时靠近村子里能吃的野果、野菜都被采摘空，为了不挨打，她只能往深山里走。
狼可不可怕她不知道，她只知道她怕极了她娘。
赵小丫不知道自己走了多久，只觉得脚步沉重得再也走不动，最后顾不得脏，直接席地而坐。
其实赵家在村子里的日子不算难过，赵老爹是个木工，平时给村里人打些桌椅板凳，偶尔还能拿到城里卖，赚的银子不少。
赵小丫却连个正经的名字都没有，只是小丫、小丫的叫着，平时在家吃不饱穿不暖，日子过得比家中养的牲畜还不如。
若是家中两个闺女日子过得样也就罢了，但大闺女赵雪却是个娇养的大小姐，放眼这十里八村没几户的闺女能像她般，穿的是上好布料，还特地进城找女夫子学琴棋书画。
赵小丫捂着脸忍不住痛哭失声。
她的日子过得苦，但是她很少哭，因为她直记得小时候住在村东的位姊姊。姊姊家里孩子多，有好东西都要给弟弟们，天天吃不饱饭，有着干不完的活，但姊姊跟她说——
“小丫笑起来很好看，像天上的月牙儿，只要小丫笑，姊姊心情就好。所以日子苦没关系，咱们就要笑，笑了日子就不苦了。”
她相信了姊姊的话，她喜欢笑。
前年姊姊被她爹娘嫁给隔壁村子死了三个老婆的老鳏夫，只因为人家出得起最多的彩礼钱，正好可以给她弟弟娶媳妇。
姊姊出嫁那天还是笑了，却比哭还难看。
出嫁后第年姊姊就上吊死了，她知道嫁得不好就跟姊姊样没有好下场，所以她不想嫁给李家傻子，她想反抗，可是最后……
想到上辈子最后的下场，赵小丫的泪水掉得更凶。
第一章 偏心的娘亲(2)
她不知道自己哭了多久，当闻到空气中带着烙饼的油香气时，她只以为自己因为饿极了产生错觉，只是这味道直不散，她放下了手，果然看到油亮的烙饼。
脸上挂着泪，赵小丫抬起头，熟悉的身影映入眼中，才刚止住的泪又猛然落下。
站在面前头发花白的老人家皱了下眉，眼底写着无奈和不舍，将手中的烙饼塞进了她的手里，如来时般不发声响的往山下走。
赵小丫连忙用力地抹去脸上的泪，拿着烙饼追了上去。
这十里八村内没人知道眼前这位严肃的老头子姓啥名谁，来自何处，只知道他是个能人，寻常人不敢进入深山，他却像走自己家，每每进山从未空手而归，前几年还曾赤手空拳打死头下山的猛虎，名震时。
“爷爷，我不饿。”赵小丫虽然饿极，却不想厚脸皮抢老人家的口粮。
老头子头也没回，继续往前走。
赵小丫看着老人家双肩上各背着头野鹿和沉沉的竹篓，就知他今日上山的成果丰厚。
吸了吸鼻子，她将烙饼塞进衣襟，伸出手想要帮忙接过竹篓。
老人家终于因为她的举动而停下脚步，转过头居高临下的看着她。
“爷爷，你让我帮把手。”赵小丫因为瘦得没几两肉，显得脸很小，但双眼睛却特别大，“不然我不好意思拿吃的。”
老头子最后没有拒绝，将竹篓给她。
赵小丫对他笑，咬着牙将竹篓给背在肩上，略微吃力的跟在他的身后。
看着前头宽厚的背，赵小丫的心思飘远。
初见老头子时赵小丫不过四、五岁的年纪，已经得忙着做家中杂活，她是在山上捡柴时遇上了初来乍到的老头子，彼时的他看来有些狼狈，似乎赶了许久的路，连鞋都破了。
当时刘彩凤天就只给她个窝窝头，她看他可怜，虽不舍但还是将自己吃剩半的窝窝头和水给他。
老头子什么也没说，吃了她的东西之后，进村子里找上村长，给了村长笔银两，在离村子约两里路的地方买了大块地，建了栋竹楼，四周种满了青竹，几年过去，那片竹林更显茂密。
老人家从不与村里的人打交道，因为长得人高马大，脸凶狠，所以寻常人也不敢接近他。
大山村里的孩子向来皮实，不少人家都用老头子恐吓孩子，说不乖的话，竹林里的老头子半夜会过来把孩子抓回去吃了。
久了之后，“竹林里的老头子会吃人”这句玩笑话深植人心，演变至今还真像有这么回事。
村子里的人无事，别说竹楼，就连竹林都不会靠近，看到老头子走来都远远的绕开。
只是赵小丫不怕他，她比任何人都清楚老爷爷是个面恶心善的好人，她在山里遇上老爷爷几次，每每他总会给她吃的。
长这么大，愿意将家中吃食分出来给她的，除了老爷爷外再无旁人。
她的手不自觉落在自己的手腕上，那是条用兽牙做成的手串。
当年老头子打死山中猛虎，不单引起十里八村的议论，就连城里都听闻威名。他将虎骨、虎肉全卖了，留下兽皮和兽牙，将兽牙串成手链，并以她在山上帮他抬东西下山为由送到赵家，特别交代是要给“赵小丫”。
刘彩凤和赵雪这么多年来碍于老头子威名，就算是眼红也不敢动手抢。
顾乔成眼角余光看到赵小丫的动作，不由在心中叹了口气。他年轻时久经战场，深信兽牙避邪之说，戴着兽牙更是坚强勇敢的象徵。他心中同情赵小丫，偏偏小丫头软弱，不知反抗，就算他想多管闲事，小丫头自己不争，他也帮不上忙。
顾乔成不动声色地留意吃力地想要跟上自己步伐的赵小丫，稍稍放慢了脚步。
赵小丫忍着身子不适，摸了摸兽牙手串。以前她不懂，以为老爷爷是看她可怜，身上没半点首饰才赠她，直到后来才知他给她兽牙的真正心意，只可惜她知道得太迟。
跟着顾乔成走进竹林，赵小丫目光带上丝怀念，村子里的人都说这里看来阴邪，但她却觉得这里是极美的地方。
上辈子她最后还是被逼着嫁进了李家，而这片竹林也被把火燃烧殆尽，连同优美的竹楼都烧得丝不剩，从此她没再见到老爷爷。
她情愿相信老爷爷离开了这里，也不想去想老爷爷可能死在这场大火之中……
穿过竹林，竹楼出现在眼前。
走在前头的顾乔成推开竹楼前的小门，赵小丫守规矩的将竹篓放在门边。
顾乔成终于开了口，“你等会儿，我割只鹿腿给你带……”
赵小丫没等顾乔成说完，转身就跑。
顾乔成看着下子就溜得没影的娇小身影，不由得叹。
content_en:
At that time, he was so happy that he would laugh even in his dreams, but such a beautiful marriage was almost worn out within a few years.
Thinking of Liu Caifeng's insistence on marrying Zhao Xiaoya to a fool, he felt reluctant and guilty, and his already thin body looked even more old.
Maybe it would be good to marry a fool... Looking at the white smoke coming out of the boiling water, Father Zhao's eyes became misty.
After leaving the Zhao family and without her mean and partial mother, Xiaoya's life should be better than it is now.
Even if he was deceiving himself, he could only live with this idea.
Zhao Xiaoya rushed out of the house in a hurry. She didn't run far before she felt like she had lost all her strength.
She gasped for air and endured dizziness. She was obviously a girl who was about to have haircuts, but her face was sallow and skinny, and she looked like a ten-year-old child at most.
She staggered up the mountain path. The village where she lived was surrounded by endless mountains. In the dead of night, she could occasionally hear the howling of wolves in the mountains.
Villagers who usually pick wild vegetables and fruits do not dare to go deep into the mountains for fear of being unlucky and encountering a pack of wolves and leaving their bodies intact.
But Zhao Xiaoya has been forced to work in the mountains since she was a child. All the edible wild fruits and vegetables near the village have been picked. In order to avoid being beaten, she can only go deep into the mountains.
She didn't know whether wolves were scary, she only knew that she was extremely afraid of her mother.
Zhao Xiaoya didn't know how long she had been walking, but she felt that her footsteps were so heavy that she couldn't walk anymore. In the end, she didn't care about being dirty and sat down on the ground.
In fact, the life of the Zhao family in the village is not difficult. Father Zhao is a carpenter. He usually makes tables, chairs and benches for the villagers, and occasionally sells them in the city, making a lot of money.
Zhao Xiaoya, on the other hand, doesn't even have a serious name. She just screams "Xiaoya, Xiaoya". She usually doesn't have enough food or clothing to keep her warm at home, and her life is worse than that of the livestock raised at home.
It would be fine if the two daughters in the family had a decent life, but the eldest daughter Zhao Xue was a pampered young lady. Looking at the daughters of few families in these ten miles and eight villages, she wore fine fabrics and even went to the city to learn music, chess, calligraphy and painting from her wife.
Zhao Xiaoya covered her face and couldn't help crying.
Her life was hard, but she rarely cried because she always remembered her sister who lived in the east of the village when she was a child. My sister has many children in her family. She has to give good things to her brothers. She doesn’t have enough to eat every day and has endless work to do. But her sister told her——
"Xiaoya smiles beautifully, like the crescent moon in the sky. As long as Xiaoya smiles, my sister will be in a good mood. So it doesn't matter if life is hard, we just have to smile, and if we smile, life will no longer be miserable."
She believed her sister's words and she liked to laugh.
The year before last, my sister was married off by her parents to an old widower from the next village whose three wives had died, just because he could afford the largest amount of gift money, which would be enough to marry her younger brother.
My sister still smiled on her wedding day, but it was uglier than crying.
Her sister hanged herself the year after she got married. She knew that if she didn't marry well, she would end up like her sister, so she didn't want to marry a fool from the Li family. She wanted to resist, but in the end...
Thinking of his final fate in his previous life, Zhao Xiaoya's tears fell even more fiercely.
Chapter 1 The Partial Mother (2)
She didn't know how long she cried. When she smelled the oily aroma of pancakes in the air, she thought she was delusional because she was extremely hungry, but the smell didn't go away. She put down her hand and saw the shiny pancakes.
With tears on her face, Zhao Xiaoya raised her head, a familiar figure came into her eyes, and the tears that had just stopped suddenly fell again.
The gray-haired old man standing in front of her frowned, with helplessness and reluctance written in his eyes. He put the pancake in her hand and walked down the mountain as silently as he had come.
Zhao Xiaoya quickly wiped away the tears on her face and chased after him with pancakes in hand.
No one in these ten miles and eight villages knew the name of the serious old man in front of him or where he came from. They only knew that he was a capable man. Ordinary people did not dare to go into the mountains, but he was like walking home. Every time he went into the mountains, he never came back empty-handed. A few years ago, he even killed a tiger that came down the mountain with his bare hands, which made him famous.
"Grandpa, I'm not hungry." Although Zhao Xiaoya was very hungry, she didn't want to shamelessly snatch the old man's rations.
The old man didn't look back and continued walking forward.
Zhao Xiaoya saw that the old man was carrying a wild deer and a heavy bamboo basket on each shoulder, and knew that he had made great achievements in going up the mountain today.
After sniffing, she stuffed the pancake into her clothes and stretched out her hand to help take the bamboo basket.
The old man finally stopped because of her actions and turned his head to look at her condescendingly.
"Grandpa, please ask me to help." Zhao Xiaoya has a small face because she is so thin, but her eyes are very big. "Otherwise, I will be embarrassed to get food."
The old man did not refuse in the end and gave her the bamboo basket.
Zhao Xiaoya smiled at him, gritted her teeth, slung the bamboo basket on her shoulders, and followed him with some difficulty.
Looking at the generous back in front of him, Zhao Xiaoya's mind wandered far away.
When she first met the old man, Zhao Xiaoya was only four or five years old and was already busy doing chores at home. She met the old man who had just arrived when she was collecting firewood in the mountains. At that time, he looked a little embarrassed. It seemed that he had traveled for a long time and even his shoes were worn out.
At that time, Liu Caifengtian only gave her a steamed bun. She thought he was pitiful, and although she was reluctant to part with it, she still gave him the half-eaten steamed bun and water.
The old man said nothing. After eating her food, he went to the village to find the village chief. He gave the village chief a pen of silver and bought a large piece of land about two miles away from the village. He built a bamboo building surrounded by green bamboos. Over the past few years, the bamboo forest has become more dense.
The old man never interacts with people in the village. Because he is tall and has a fierce face, ordinary people dare not approach him.
Children in Dashan Village have always been good-natured, and many families use old men to intimidate their children. If they do not behave well, the old man from the bamboo forest will come over in the middle of the night to catch the children and eat them.
After a long time, the joke "the old man in the bamboo forest can eat people" became deeply rooted in people's hearts, and it has evolved to this day and it seems to be true.
The people in the village were fine. Not to mention the bamboo house, they would not even come close to the bamboo forest. They would stay away when they saw the old man approaching.
It's just that Zhao Xiaoya is not afraid of him. She knows better than anyone else that the old man is a kind-hearted man. She met the old man several times in the mountains, and he always gave her something to eat.
When she grew up, there was no one except her grandfather who was willing to share the food at home for her.
Her hand unconsciously fell on her wrist, which was a bracelet made of animal teeth.
When the old man killed a tiger in the mountains, it not only caused discussion in villages all over the country, but also spread the word in the city. He sold all the tiger bones and meat, leaving the skins and tusks behind. He strung the tusks into bracelets and sent them to Zhao's house on the pretext that she was helping him carry things down the mountain, specifically saying that they were to be given to "Zhao Xiaoya".
Due to the old man's reputation over the years, Liu Caifeng and Zhao Xue did not dare to snatch it even if they were jealous.
Gu Qiaocheng saw Zhao Xiaoya's movements from the corner of his eye and couldn't help but sigh in his heart. When he was young, he experienced many battles and firmly believed in the theory that animal teeth can ward off evil spirits. Wearing animal teeth is a symbol of strength and bravery. He sympathized with Zhao Xiaoya in his heart, but the little girl was weak and didn't know how to resist. Even if he wanted to meddle in his own business, he couldn't help if the little girl didn't fight.
Gu Qiaocheng calmly paid attention to Zhao Xiaoya, who was struggling to keep up with him, and slowed down slightly.
Zhao Xiaoya endured the discomfort and touched the animal tooth bracelet. She didn't understand it before and thought that her grandfather gave it to her because he felt pity for her because he didn't have any jewelry. It wasn't until later that she realized his true intention of giving her the animal tooth. It was a pity that she knew it too late.
Following Gu Qiaocheng into the bamboo forest, Zhao Xiaoya's eyes were filled with nostalgia. People in the village said that this place looked sinister, but she thought it was a very beautiful place.
In her previous life, she was finally forced to marry into the Li family, and the bamboo forest was burned to the ground, along with the beautiful bamboo building. She never saw her grandfather again.
She would rather believe that grandpa has left here, and does not want to think that grandpa may have died in the fire...
Passing through the bamboo forest, the bamboo building appears in front of you.
Gu Qiaocheng, who was walking in front, pushed open the small door in front of the bamboo building, and Zhao Xiaoya obeyed the rules and placed the bamboo basket by the door.
Gu Qiaocheng finally spoke, "Wait a moment, I'll cut off a deer leg and bring it to you..."
Zhao Xiaoya turned around and ran away before Gu Qiaocheng finished speaking.
Gu Qiaocheng couldn't help but sigh as he looked at the petite figure that disappeared all of a sudden.
